purpose: Routing examples, not a provider catalog or verified capability ranking.
note: model_classes is the flat list the offline task-graph checker accepts as model_class; classes are resolved from LhcPlan list_models at runtime.

frontier.label: Frontier
frontier.use: Strongest suitable available model for Lead, hard decisions, decomposition, difficult oversight and council.

middle.label: Middle
middle.use: Code written from a ready plan with a bounded acceptance check.

fast.label: Fast
fast.use: Well-specified routine execution and checks where verified capability suffices.

runtime_catalog: Resolve from the active harness/provider catalog; never send user_examples blindly as API model IDs.
fallback: Use a suitable available model with a recorded limitation. Never claim an unattested model choice or council diversity.

frontier_thresholds.frontier: coding score >= minimum score of named frontier anchors
frontier_thresholds.fast: coding score <= maximum score among fast-named families
frontier_thresholds.middle: coding score between fast and frontier cuts
frontier_thresholds.source: config/models.json -> coding_benchmark; list_models reports resolved thresholds
